question_set.question: Use sort_bars with order equal to descending and use highlight_top_n with n equal to 2 in order to know What are the key characteristics of calorie distribution across Starbucks beverage categories, and which categories show the most significant differences?

answer.value: Starbucks beverage categories show a wide range of average calories, from Coffee at only 4.2 calories to Smoothies at 282.2 calories. The top 5 highest-calorie categories (Smoothies, Frappuccino Blended Coffee, Signature Espresso Drinks, Frappuccino Blended Crème, and Tazo Tea Drinks) all average above 177 calories, while Coffee stands out as exceptionally low-calorie. The most significant differences exist between blended/creamy beverages (high calories) and plain coffee (very low calories).

key_insights: Smoothies have the highest average calories (282.2)
Coffee has exceptionally low average calories (4.2)
significantly lower than all other categories
Blended and creamy beverages tend to have higher calorie content

reasoning_trace.rationale: Sort bars in descending order to visualize the calorie distribution across all beverage categories
Highlight the top 5 categories to focus on the highest-calorie beverages for detailed analysis
